diff-upstream.//: Verify the vendored copy is byte-identical to its pinned upstream commit. Exits non-zero on drift, so it doubles as a CI guard for ADR-0001.

diff-latest.//: Informational: what an upgrade to the tip of the tracked branch would pull in.

sync.//: Re-vendor at a new upstream ref. Refuses to run if the current copy has drifted, so local changes are never silently discarded. Usage: nx run site-v5:sync --args="--ref=<commit|branch>"

install.//: Install the vendored copy's own dependencies. Upstream uses npm, and its versions conflict with the v4 tree at the repo root, so this is deliberately isolated from the root pnpm install.

build.//: Build the vendored Quartz. Defaults to its own docs/ as content until the migration points it at content/public.

serve.//: Dev server for the vendored Quartz.

clean.//: Remove build output and caches from the vendored copy.
